description: This file defines the NullCoalesceBinary class which implements the null coalescing operator (`??`) for Twig's expression parser. It provides functionality to handle null checks and optimizations when compiling Twig templates.

classes.name: NullCoalesceBinary
classes.description: Final class implementing the null coalescing operator (`??`) for Twig, handling null checks, optimized compilation, and operator representation within Twig expressions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a NullCoalesceBinary operator node, initializing test conditions for non-NameExpression left nodes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code, optimizing for the presence of test nodes.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Outputs the PHP representation of the null coalescing operator (`??`).

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns operand names that need escaping based on the presence of a test node.
